source_name: Google Play / Apple App Store listings for MK wallet and payment apps (MyIute, Paysera, bank wallets)
why_relevant: App-store listings give release cadence, feature changelogs, install-count bands and user reviews for MK wallets — a proxy for adoption where no operator discloses user numbers. Especially valuable for MyIute and any new EMI wallet.

source_name: Printec North Macedonia (Printec Technology DOOEL Skopje) - country site
why_relevant: Regional ATM/self-service integrator present in MK since 2006; country page and case studies name banking customers (e.g. Komercijalna Banka) and describe ATM fleet supply/maintenance and software upgrades, disclosing installed base and refresh activity that no public portal shows.

source_name: Asseco SEE DOOEL Skopje (formerly Pexim) - corporate site
why_relevant: Largest SEE banking-software vendor with a Skopje entity; supplies core banking (Oracle/MS based), omnichannel, regulatory reporting and risk systems to MK banks. Company profile, references and news pages reveal which MK banks run which platforms and when they were replaced.

source_name: Asseco SEE Group annual / management report (segment disclosures)
why_relevant: Listed-group reporting breaks revenue by segment (Banking Solutions, Payments/Payten) and by country, and describes ATM outsourcing (MoneyGet) and independent EFT-POS (Monri) networks. Gives quantified, auditable vendor-side signals about MK payments infrastructure spend.

source_name: Payten (Asseco payments brand) - corporate site
why_relevant: Payten is the payments arm covering ATM and POS services, processing, e-commerce and mPayments across SEE including MK; its about/news/solutions pages surface terminal deployments, acquiring partners and outsourcing deals that indicate MK POS estate ownership.

source_name: MoneyGet (Asseco independent ATM network) - regional sites as MK proxy
why_relevant: Independent/white-label ATM network brand operated across SEE; partner and locations pages enumerate deployed ATMs and partner merchants. Useful to test whether an IAD (independent ATM deployer) layer exists in MK, which materially changes ATM-count interpretation of central-bank statistics.

source_name: NCR Atleos - corporate newsroom and partner/case-study pages
why_relevant: Global ATM hardware/software and ATM-as-a-Service vendor; press releases and case studies are the usual disclosure channel for bank ATM refresh wins in small markets like MK, and its partner/channel pages identify the local reseller that serves MK banks.

source_name: Diebold Nixdorf - newsroom, case studies and partner network
why_relevant: The other major ATM/self-service OEM competing for SEE bank estates; case studies and regional press releases disclose bank customers and fleet sizes, and its partner listings identify the MK channel. No MK-specific item was found in this pass, so treat as a monitoring source.

source_name: Ingenico - products and partner/distributor pages
why_relevant: Dominant POS terminal OEM in SEE; terminal model pages plus partner/where-to-buy directories are the route to identify who supplies MK acquirers, and model announcements indicate terminal generation refresh cycles visible later in MK POS counts.

source_name: Verifone - acquiring solutions and partner pages
why_relevant: POS OEM and acquiring-services provider; its acquirer-facing pages and press releases occasionally name SEE acquirers and estate migrations, an indirect signal on MK POS terminal supply.

source_name: PAX Technology - global partner/distributor network
why_relevant: Fast-growing Android-POS OEM increasingly displacing incumbents in SEE; distributor listings would identify the MK importer and thereby the acquirers moving to smartPOS. URL provided from vendor-name knowledge, not confirmed in this pass - low confidence.

source_name: KIBS AD Skopje (Клириншка куќа КИБС) - payment services and news
why_relevant: National clearing house for small-value interbank payments and, since 2025, licensed instant-payments operator; also runs PKI/trust services via KIBStrust. Its service and news pages document the shared infrastructure layer all MK banks and terminal vendors plug into, and it is listed on the Macedonian Stock Exchange so financial disclosures exist.

source_name: Nikob DOOEL Skopje (Никоб) - security and cash-services company
why_relevant: Reported operator of the largest cash-processing centre in the region (Центар за кеш услуги) handling processing, storage and transport of cash for banks and retailers. Cash-in-transit and cash-centre capacity is a direct proxy for cash usage and for banks outsourcing cash handling.

source_name: Perpetum Mobile Security / Obezbeduvanje (Перпетум Мобиле) - cash transfer services
why_relevant: Major MK private security firm offering 'Трансфер на дневен промет' - collecting retail daily takings, secure transport to its cash centre/vault and depositing into commercial banks. Business-press profiling of its revenue and volumes is an indirect measure of cash intensity and of bank cash-handling outsourcing.

source_name: NLB Banka AD Skopje - NLB Кеш центар (bank-operated cash centre)
why_relevant: A bank offering a commercial cash-centre service to other companies and even other banks - evidence of the MK cash-management value chain and of in-house vs outsourced models; paired with NLB cash-in ATM communications it indicates deposit-automation rollout.

source_name: Nextsense DOO Skopje (Некстсенс) - digital identity / banking software vendor
why_relevant: Skopje-based software vendor active in digital signing/identity and financial-sector projects; customer and reference pages point to MK bank digitalisation projects. Corporate registries (companywall.mk, club200.mk) give revenue/headcount trends as a proxy for bank IT spend.

source_name: Semos DOO Skopje (СЕМОС) - IT integrator serving financial sector
why_relevant: Long-established Skopje IT consulting/integration firm (since 1995) supplying computer equipment and services; a likely channel for bank infrastructure. Registry profile gives financials; its own site would carry customer references.

source_name: Duna Skopje (Дуна) - software and billing/fiscal solutions vendor
why_relevant: Established MK IT vendor with software and billing-solution lines; vendors in this segment typically also distribute and service fiscal cash registers and integrated POS, making their product/service pages a route to the fiscal-device and merchant-terminal estate.

source_name: zk.mk business directory - software / banking / ATM categories
why_relevant: Macedonian yellow-pages style directory with category listings for software firms, banks and ATM locations; a cheap way to enumerate candidate vendors, integrators and terminal distributors that never appear in English search results.

source_name: yellowpages.com.mk - MK company directory
why_relevant: Second independent MK directory useful for cross-checking vendor existence, addresses and category tagging (security/CIT firms, IT integrators, fiscal-device servicers) when a vendor has no web presence.

source_name: Komercijalna Banka AD Skopje investor presentations (vendor-estate proxy)
why_relevant: Listed MK bank publishing periodic presentations with channel/network figures (ATMs, POS, cards). As a named Printec reference customer, its disclosed device counts calibrate vendor installed-base claims and refresh timing.

source_name: AmCham North Macedonia member directory
why_relevant: Member profiles (Asseco SEE among them) give verified legal entity names, addresses and business-line descriptions for technology vendors operating in MK - a clean seed list for the vendor actor map. The Macedonian-Bulgarian chamber (mbcham.org) plays the same role for security/cash firms.

source_name: EMIS company profiles - North Macedonia technology vendors
why_relevant: Commercial database with MK entity profiles, executives and financials for vendor subsidiaries (Asseco SEE DOOEL, Printec Technology DOOEL). Useful to size the local vendor footprint, though largely paywalled.
